Repository: https://github.com/WerWolv/libtesla
Commit: f766e9b607a05e9756843cbd62b3bfb98be1646c
Files vendored: include/tesla.hpp, include/stb_truetype.h, LICENSE
Local support header: include/playwise_glyph_cache.hpp (not an upstream file).
Local compatibility patch: tesla.hpp replaces its sole dynamic_cast with a
List-parent static_cast so the overlay can honor -fno-rtti.
Local Device Lab patch: defining TESLA_FORCE_CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED_FONT makes the
internal forensic overlay load Nintendo's Simplified Chinese shared font even
when the console language is not Chinese. Normal overlay builds do not define it.
Local correctness patch: List focus traversal uses an underflow-safe reverse
loop for its unsigned focused index.
Local PlayWise font patch: load both Nintendo Chinese shared fonts, select each
glyph from the available faces, and include the chosen language in the glyph
cache key. This supports Simplified and Traditional UI text on either system
language without changing the upstream commit recorded above.
Local overlay memory patch: restrict emoji font search to overlay-specific paths
and cap maximum file size to 256KB to prevent ovlloader 4MB heap exhaustion.
Local resource patch (2026-10-13): fixed metadata for at most 512 cached glyphs,
256KiB bitmap budget, pre-allocation eviction, owning bitmap deleters and
renderer-exit cleanup. Transparent text measurement never rasterizes a glyph.
PlayWise defines TESLA_DISABLE_EMOJI_FONT to skip unused SD font loading.
Local lifecycle patch (2026-10-13): atomic cross-thread flags, UI-thread-only
hide handling, input snapshots outside IPC/SD work, and event lifetime spanning
thread startup through join. Parse settings on the main thread before starting
the 4KiB-stack input poller. The pinned upstream commit remains unchanged.
